name: build-system-integrator
description: Detect local build systems, list targets, run a bounded target, and parse compiler-style errors.
author: madicen

entries.name: detect_build_tool
entries.body: Detect the primary build tool under root_path (make, go, npm, cargo, python) and list matching config files.

entries.name: list_build_targets
entries.body: List known build targets for the detected tool under root_path.

entries.name: run_build_target
entries.body: Run one allowlisted build target under root_path with a short timeout; return exit_code and output_tail.

fields.params: [{"name":"root_path","description":"Absolute path to the project root","required":true},{"name":"target","description":"Target name (e.g. hello, build, test)","required":true}]

entries.name: parse_build_errors
entries.body: Parse compiler-style file:line: message lines from a build log string.
